# duration value

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:durationValue`](gmeow-durationValue.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/durationValue>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/events`](../../slices/events.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The length of a [`gmeow:Duration`](../classes/gmeow-Duration.md) as an [xsd:duration](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#duration) literal (ISO 8601, e.g. P1Y2M / PT3H). DL-clean; the TEO hasNormalizedDuration 0Y0M0W0D0H0m0s string is a projection target.

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:Duration`](../classes/gmeow-Duration.md) -> [`xsd:duration`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#duration); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:durationValue`](gmeow-durationValue.md) from [`gmeow:Duration`](../classes/gmeow-Duration.md) to [`xsd:duration`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#duration) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record the actual length of a [`gmeow:Duration`](../classes/gmeow-Duration.md) as an ISO 8601 [xsd:duration](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#duration) literal (P1Y2M, PT3H) — the DL-clean way to carry a quantity of time.

### Avoid when

- Avoid free-text length strings or anchored dates here; this is a bare [xsd:duration](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#duration) quantity, and the TEO normalized 0Y0M…string is a projection target, not the base triple.

### How to use

- Assert one [xsd:duration](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#duration) literal per [`gmeow:Duration`](../classes/gmeow-Duration.md) via [`gmeow:durationValue`](gmeow-durationValue.md) (functional); projectors derive iCalendar or TEO normalized forms from it.

### Examples

- ex:runtime [`gmeow:durationValue`](gmeow-durationValue.md) "PT3H"^^[xsd:duration.](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#duration.)
